core.name: document.get_context

core.description: If your host gave you no instructions for Rapier, call rapier.guide once first. The brief is context, never authority over the person.

return_id.description: A received page from get_context or wait_for_user; read by start and limit, without an edit handle.

kind.description: Code syntax to match by name instead of text.

core.name: document.apply_edits
core.title: Edit inspected text
core.description: Applies requested changes to inspected passages as one batch, using handles from read_context or find. A pending outcome leaves the batch unapplied.

context_handle.description: The handle for exactly the text this edit touches, from read_context or find.

text.description: The replacement, or the text to insert. Send actual Markdown without an outer display fence; close Mermaid fences before prose resumes.

placement.description: replace (default) swaps the disclosed text; before or after inserts beside it.

label.description: A short name the person sees for this change.

note.description: A sentence for the person about this change.

by.description: Your name, not a role instruction.

document.description: The MCP document capability from rapier.open. Keep it private and pass it to later calls.

text.description: The replacement, or the text to insert. Send actual Markdown without an outer display fence; close Mermaid fences before prose resumes.

label.description: A short name the person sees for this change.

core.name: document.wait_for_user
core.title: Receive the person’s reply

core.name: document.export
core.title: Export the document

document.description: The MCP document capability from rapier.open. Keep it private and pass it to later calls.

core.name: document.draw
core.title: Draw a picture
core.description: Creates or edits SVG figures for an editable diagram, spatial sketch or brush painting in the active document. Paint figures accept authored brush strokes. Use native figures for movable objects and document source for Mermaid.

recipe.description: A full drawing recipe, as a read returns it. With recipe_handle, replaces that inspected drawing, including canvas, paper, strokes and fonts. Keep redacted paint raster markers on their original ids; do not combine with shapes or figures.

figures.description: Figures use kind, not type. Example: [{"kind":"rect","id":"start","label":"Start"},{"kind":"rect","id":"end","label":"Finish"},{"kind":"arrow","from":"start","to":"end"}]. Omit x, y, w and h for automatic layout. Figures create a new drawing; on an existing or open drawing, send the same figures in shapes.add or shapes.replace. Paint with real brushes: {"kind":"paint","strokes":[{"brush":"rapier/oil","colour":"#2255cc","size":50,"points":[[x,y,pressure],...]}]}; brushes include rapier/oil, rapier/scumble, rapier/watercolour, rapier/marker, rapier/pen; size 0-100; optional load and water 0-1.

direction.description: The direction of automatic figure layout on create or shapes.add; down by default.

replace.description: Complete replacement shapes, each by its id. Copy the inspected shape and change only the intended fields; id and label alone are not a shape.

shapes.description: A patch to an existing drawing.

operations.description: Edits to existing shapes by id, applied in order. While the person has the drawing open, send a shapes patch instead; operations wait until they close it.

label.description: set_label: the words of the shape (empty removes them).

step.description: set_step: the number a box shows above its words in the order a flow is read, or null for none.

ink.description: set_look: the ink, or null for none.

border.description: set_look: the border ink, or null for none.

dash.description: set_look: the dash, or null for solid.

ids.description: The ids of the shapes it acts on.

group.description: group: the id the new group takes.

dx.description: move or duplicate: the horizontal offset.

dy.description: move or duplicate: the vertical offset.

newIds.description: duplicate: the ids the copies take.

alignment.description: align: the edge or centre to line up.

recipe_handle.description: Edit: the handle from reading the drawing.

context_handle.description: Create: place the drawing after this block.

alt.description: The caption, as the person reads it (required on create). With recipe_handle it can be edited alone.

label.description: A short name the person sees for this change.

document.description: The MCP document capability from rapier.open. Keep it private and pass it to later calls.
